items:
A work permit must be issued, the qualified 
 maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required.

Wear the appropriate 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety shoes, helmet ... etc

Motor is out of service for some works if 
 necessary.

Switch off the CB and 
 withdraw it from its cell.

Switch off the DC power 
 supply for this CB.

Open the junction box and check 
 the cable terminals tightening any loose bolt if any.

Clean the body of the motor and 
 ventilation holes using air blower.

Clean the local and tightening 
 the terminals.

Grease the ball bearing after 
 3000 hours running.

Measure the insulation resistance 
 of the motor winding Using Megger 2500v.

text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, which must be performed every three months as indicated 
by M3 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Mohammed Mostafa El-Zalbane, tested by eng. 
Samir Ouf Hasoob, accepted by general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam, approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of Damanhour power station and
certified by eng. Sania 
Diab Attia: WDEPC Inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified 
 maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required.
Wear the appropriate 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety shoes, helmet ... etc
Motor is out of service for some works if 
 necessary.
Switch off the CB and 
 withdraw it from its cell.
Switch off the DC power 
 supply for this CB.
Tools and 
Equipment
Electrical equipment kit.
Megger 2500v.
Dry Cloth.
Work to be carried out
Open the junction box and check 
 the cable terminals tightening any loose bolt if any.
Clean the junction box.
Clean the body of the motor and 
 ventilation holes using air blower.
Clean the local and tightening 
 the terminals.
Grease the ball bearing after 
 3000 hours running.
Measure the insulation resistance 
 of the motor winding Using Megger 2500v.
